item.title: Macotate 1.0.1
item.description:
Macotate 1.0.1

  • Improved document pasting: preserve formatting within the same document and match surrounding text when pasting from elsewhere.
  • New Document Editor settings for fonts, pasting, spelling, padding lines and drawing outside pages.
  • Improved undo support for document edits, PDF changes and AI composer text.
  • Improved toolbar activation, compact/document transitions and canvas ownership across separate Spaces.
  • Updated AI assistant, diagram editing and colour requests.
  • Diagrams use pastel fills and readable labels, with a 10% opaque white preview background.
  • AI prompt panels have larger move headers and keep keyboard focus when moved.
  • Diagram prompts remain visible during generation; Return submits follow-up changes.
